description: This file defines a subclass NebiusConfig that extends OpenAIGPTConfig to customize parameter mapping for OpenAI-compatible chat completion models, specifically for Nebius AI Studio. It includes a method to map certain parameters, notably translating 'max_completion_tokens' to 'max_tokens'.

classes.name: NebiusConfig
classes.description: A configuration class that customizes how OpenAI parameters are mapped, extending the base OpenAIGPTConfig class.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps 'max_completion_tokens' parameter to 'max_tokens' and includes supported openai parameters into optional_params.

ctags.name: map_openai_params
ctags.signature: ( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
